# apple_analytics_report_requests (Data Source)

Lists the analytics report requests of an app.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_analytics_report_requests" "ongoing" {
  app_id       = data.apple_app.example.id
  access_types = ["ONGOING"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.

### Optional

- `access_types` (Set of String) Kinds of request to list. Values: `ONGOING`, `ONE_TIME_SNAPSHOT`.

### Read-Only

- `requests` (Attributes List) The requests. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--requests))

<a id="nestedatt--requests"></a>
### Nested Schema for `requests`

Read-Only:

- `access_type` (String) Kind of request: `ONGOING`, `ONE_TIME_SNAPSHOT`.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the request.
- `stopped_due_to_inactivity` (Boolean) Whether App Store Connect stopped the request because its reports were not downloaded.
